baryonic_mass.description: Declared cold baryonic mass: total stars plus cold gas.

bulge_stellar_mass.description: Bulge stellar mass, a subset of total stellar mass.

cold_gas_mass.description: Total SAGE cold star-forming gas reservoir.
cold_gas_mass.qualification: SAGE does not natively split this reservoir into HI and H2.

cold_gas_metal_mass.description: Total metal mass in the cold-gas reservoir.

galaxy_type.description: SAGE type: 0 central, 1 resolved satellite, 2 orphan.

host_halo_mass.description: FoF central halo virial mass stamped onto each member.

hot_gas_mass.description: Hot halo gas assigned to the galaxy record.

maximum_circular_velocity.description: Maximum circular velocity of the owning subhalo or inherited infall value.

position.description: Comoving galaxy position inherited from the owning halo.

sage_cooling_power.description: SAGE cumulative cooling-energy proxy converted to logarithmic power.
sage_cooling_power.qualification: This is not an instantaneous cooling mass rate.

sage_heating_power.description: SAGE cumulative AGN-heating proxy converted to logarithmic power.
sage_heating_power.qualification: This is not the same output as SHARK mechanical jet power.

stellar_disk_radius.qualification: This is a scale radius, not SHARK's disk half-mass radius.

stellar_mass.description: Total stellar mass, including the bulge component.

stellar_metal_mass.description: Total stellar metal mass, already including bulge metals.
stellar_metal_mass.qualification: MetalsBulgeMass is a subset and must not be added to MetalsStellarMass.

subhalo_mass.description: Galaxy-owning halo/subhalo virial mass; orphans have zero.
subhalo_mass.qualification: SAGE uses M200c for centrals and particle mass for subhalos.

velocity.description: Galaxy peculiar velocity inherited from the owning halo.

agn_mechanical_power_relation.reason: agn_mechanical_power: fiducial SAGE16 outputs a heating proxy, not jet power

atomic_gas_mass_function.reason: atomic_gas_mass: fiducial SAGE16 outputs only total cold gas

baryonic_mass_function.reason: This declared cold-baryon definition excludes hot, ejected, and diffuse reservoirs.

baryonic_tully_fisher.reason: Vmax ownership for satellites/orphans and the observational velocity proxy must be declared.

black_hole_spin_relation.reason: black_hole_spin: fiducial SAGE16 does not evolve black-hole spin

burst_fraction_relation.reason: burst_star_formation_rate: fiducial SAGE16 outputs only total snapshot-averaged SFR

cold_gas_fraction.reason: Cold-phase definitions are similar but not mathematically identical across SAMs. SAGE does not natively split this reservoir into HI and H2.

cold_gas_mass_function.reason: Cold-phase definitions are similar but not mathematically identical across SAMs. SAGE does not natively split this reservoir into HI and H2.

cooling_rate_relation.reason: cooling_rate: SAGE's public Cooling field is an energy proxy, not a mass rate

diffuse_stellar_relation.reason: SAGE ICS and SHARK stellar-halo boundaries arise from different stripping prescriptions. SAGE uses its 200-critical virial-mass convention.

ejected_gas_relation.reason: The location and ownership of the ejected reservoir differ between models. SAGE uses its 200-critical virial-mass convention.

gas_metallicity.reason: This is not an oxygen-line calibration; comparison to 12+log(O/H) needs a convention. SAGE does not natively split this reservoir into HI and H2.

hot_gas_relation.reason: Reservoir ownership across satellites and FoF groups must be aligned. SAGE uses its 200-critical virial-mass convention.

molecular_gas_mass_function.reason: molecular_gas_mass: fiducial SAGE16 outputs only total cold gas

spatial_clustering.reason: Requires the same simulation volume, cosmology, periodic boundary, and selection.

stellar_angular_momentum_relation.reason: stellar_angular_momentum: fiducial SAGE16 does not output component angular momentum

stellar_halo_relation.reason: Host-mass definitions and central selection must be aligned. SAGE uses its 200-critical virial-mass convention.

stellar_metallicity.reason: MetalsBulgeMass is a subset and must not be added to MetalsStellarMass.

stellar_size_relation.reason: SAGE and SHARK radius definitions differ and must remain visible. This is a scale radius, not SHARK's disk half-mass radius.

agn_bolometric_luminosity.description: AGN bolometric luminosity in the native SHARK output convention.

agn_mechanical_power.description: AGN mechanical power in the native SHARK output convention.

atomic_gas_mass.description: Total disk plus bulge atomic hydrogen mass.

baryonic_mass.description: Declared cold baryonic mass: total stars plus cold gas.

burst_star_formation_rate.description: Star-formation rate in merger- and disk-instability-triggered bursts.

cold_gas_mass.description: Total disk plus bulge cold gas.
cold_gas_mass.qualification: SHARK partitions cold gas into atomic and molecular components internally.

cold_gas_metal_mass.description: Total metal mass in disk plus bulge cold gas.

cooling_rate.description: Instantaneous cooling rate of the hot-halo component.

ejected_gas_mass.description: SHARK reheated/ejected reservoir; its boundary differs from SAGE's EjectedGas.
ejected_gas_mass.qualification: Reservoir boundaries must be aligned before interpreting a SAGE comparison.

galaxy_type.description: SHARK type: 0 central, 1 resolved satellite, 2 orphan.

host_halo_mass.qualification: SHARK's native virial-mass convention follows the input catalogue.

lost_gas_mass.description: Gas explicitly lost beyond the tracked halo reservoirs.

maximum_circular_velocity.description: Maximum circular velocity of the owning subhalo or inherited value.

molecular_gas_mass.description: Total disk plus bulge molecular hydrogen mass.

position.description: Comoving galaxy position; SHARK samples type-2 orphans in the host NFW halo.
position.qualification: Orphan positions include SHARK's stochastic NFW sampling convention.

star_formation_rate.description: Total disk plus burst star-formation rate.

stellar_angular_momentum.description: Specific angular momentum of disk stars in SHARK's native convention.

stellar_disk_radius.qualification: This is a half-mass radius, not SAGE's exponential scale radius.

stellar_mass.description: Total disk plus bulge stellar mass.

stellar_metal_mass.description: Total metal mass in disk plus bulge stars.

Concentration, half-mass radius, and spin reliability conventions must match SHARK.
SAGE's M200c/particle-count fallback and subhalo ordering must be defined.
